summary: The candidate is correct. Concavity of the fiber-volume root propagates the common value from the box vertices, and the equal value at the interior grid point forces constancy throughout the box. Equality in Brunn--Minkowski then makes every pair of fibers translates, equality in the fiber inclusion gives exact Minkowski interpolation, and uniqueness of translation vectors yields an affine centroid field. That affine centroid map hits every half-metronoid midpoint set, so R_C(q)=Q_q and Delta_C(q)=0; the zero stress is therefore a dual optimizer of zero load, and load minimality together with the full-dimensional dual norms forces every v_e and omega_e to vanish. The complete-graph degree and mass calculations and the conditional canonical-reservoir alias are exact. Finally, the orthonormal second difference has norm sqrt(6), while the perturbation second difference has norm at most 4 delta lambda, giving precisely the stated strict obstruction delta<sqrt(6)/4.
